posts.title: How a Guillotine league [works.]
posts.lead: The format that makes every single week a playoff game.

posts.title: Lowest score each week [gets chopped.]
posts.lead: No byes from losing. No “we’ll get them next week.” One bad week and you’re out.

posts.title: Their roster [hits waivers.]
posts.lead: Every chopped team’s players drop to the wire. Week after week, stars come free.

posts.title: So your [FAAB] is your lifeline.
posts.lead: Spend too early and you’re broke when the best roster drops. Spend too late and you never make it there.
